doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Jimmy Noon, Nene Quacku and the barbers
title: Last time Tom heard Buddy Bolden; Odd Fellows and Creole halls; the Chaperons
summary: Tom recalls the last time he heard Buddy Bolden's band, with Bob Lyons on bass, in a hall. The men disagree on whether it was Economy Hall, the Creole Hall or the two-storey Odd Fellows hall, then talk about the Chaperon brothers.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: That's his niece, I think. They were living right there. Yeah. Well, I know the last time I heard Buddy Bolden, Carnish, and the old man who played the bass, what is his name again? Bob Lyons. Bob Lyons and this other fellow played guitar, I don't know him. And he was playing in the economy hall, right on the same. What street that you thought where the economy hall was, where the man of them was living?

Not the economy hall. No, the old fellow's hall. No, no, no. You talk about the... Right in that point, the old fellow's hall. No, no, that wasn't the old fellow's hall. That's the hall the chaperon used to take here there. Oh, you're talking about the Creole Hall there.
That's where there is. Yeah. But he's talking about the old fellow's hall.
Well, there was a big old fellow's hall.
I believe it's still there, maybe. It is.
Two-throw's hall, but they cut it down to one story. Yeah.
Well, didn't they have the old leave you? The street there, that's where the other hall was. On, on Velette. Velette.
That's where the... That's where Fesson was living out there.
Yeah. I remember he showed us his house.
Yeah. Yeah. Out there. But now the old fellow's hall was... Verette and Horner. It's there yet, but they done cut it down. But now you take them chaperons. Remember them chaperons? Yeah.
Emile. Oh, two, three brothers. One of them used to play bass.

No, no. No, not at all. One of them used to play bass. What do you name fell in that hatch? Robay. Robay Chaperon. That's right. Robay Chaperon. Robay Chaperon. Robay. That's right. Well now that's... That hall out there. What they call that... Secret Hot Hall. Secret Hot Hall. Secret Hot Hall.
